propositions: The shared webhook/rerun secret is logged in plaintext in uvicorn access logs because both endpoints authenticate via query string parameter ?token=, which appears in the request line and flows to journald
The exposed secret is a Gerrit credential (GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN) that grants both review privileges and bot access, making the blast radius wider than the receiver container
The token must be moved from the query string to an HTTP header (X-Rebar-Token) for both endpoints and the access log must be redacted to prevent future leakage
Gerrit's webhook plugin configuration must be updated to send the token via the X-Rebar-Token header instead of the query string
The operator runbook for /rerun must be rewritten to use the header mechanism instead of instructing placement of the token in a URL
The currently-exposed token must be rotated and the rotation must be tracked explicitly and separately from the code fix
